name: SpaceAGORA.jl
mission: High-fidelity spacecraft orbit and atmospheric-flight simulation with GNC subsystem development. Design Reference Missions: Attitude Determination Subsystem (DRM 1), Closed-Loop Attitude Control (DRM 2), Absolute Orbit Determination (DRM 3), Active Thermal Control (DRM 4), FDIR/Safe-Mode Manager (DRM 5).
compileIntent: Implement, test, and integrate new GNC subsystems (sensor models, estimators, controllers, FDIR) into the SpaceAGORA.jl simulation framework using the effector + PeriodicCallback pattern. Each subsystem plugs into calcNavigationEffect!, calcGuidanceEffect!, or calcControlEffect!. Implementation language: Julia.
